title: B1.10 transaction-state classification and worker-local rollback capsule
principle: rollback coverage does not imply persistent column-state ownership
ownership_rules: The capsule does not extend canonical_state_t or transaction_state_t.
Large capsule arrays are allocatable and exist only for active worker trials.
Forcing values are not persistent physical state.
Accounting values are rollback/reporting data and are not physical continuation state.
dayfix and nirri are included in the capsule for rollback but remain candidates for optional persistent irrigation-process state.
No full physical transaction adapter may be admitted until crop/WOFOST, thermal and solute continuation state are qualified.
